dialogue.content: 相談ありがとうございます。よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Thank you for reaching out. I look forward to working with you.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Thank you. I look forward to it as well.

dialogue.content: はじめに年齢、性別、今日は相談したいことをよろしくお願いいたします
dialogue.English: To start, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you would like to discuss today?

dialogue.content: 19歳、女性です。自分の感情や考えを周りの人達に伝える事が苦手で、本音が言えないのが辛いです。
dialogue.English: I'm 19 and female. I have a hard time expressing my feelings and thoughts to others, and it's painful that I can't say what I truly feel.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。そうなんですね。
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing. I see.

dialogue.content: お名前はなんとお呼びしたらいいですか❔
dialogue.English: What would you like me to call you?

dialogue.content: ハナでお願いします。
dialogue.English: Please call me Hana.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。ハナさん
dialogue.English: Thank you, Hana.

dialogue.content: 相談したいことについてもう少し詳しく聴いてもいいでしょうか❔
dialogue.English: Could I hear a bit more about what you'd like to discuss?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 周りの人に感情や考え、本音を言えないのはどんの方とですか？特定ではないですか
dialogue.English: With whom do you find it difficult to express your emotions, thoughts, and true feelings? Is it with specific people, or is it more general?

dialogue.content: 特定では無く、どの人に対してもです。
dialogue.English: It's not with anyone specific; it's with everyone.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 本音が言えないのはとてもしんどいですね。
dialogue.English: It must be very tough not being able to say what you truly feel.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。本音が言えないときのハナさんのお気持ちはどう、感じてることが多いですか？
dialogue.English: I can imagine. When you can't say what you truly feel, what do you usually feel, Hana?

dialogue.content: 嫌われたくないと思っているかもしれないです。
dialogue.English: I think I might be worried about being disliked.

dialogue.content: 嫌われたくないですもんね。
dialogue.English: It’s natural not to want to be disliked.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 否定されたらどうしようもない気持ちになったりもしますし
dialogue.English: And if you're rejected, it can also leave you feeling helpless.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 周りの家族や友人に相談できる人はいらっしゃいますか❔
dialogue.English: Do you have any family or friends you can talk to about this?

dialogue.content: いないかも知れないです。
dialogue.English: I don't think so.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 一番話しやすい人はいらっしゃいますか❔
dialogue.English: Is there anyone you find easiest to talk to?

dialogue.content: 親と友達は、普通には話しています。
dialogue.English: I talk normally with my parents and friends.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。親御さんと友人には普通に話せてるんですね
dialogue.English: I see. So you're able to talk normally with your parents and friends.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: その他の人に特にどんな時に感情を出せないことが多いでしょうか❔
dialogue.English: Aside from them, in what kinds of situations do you most often find it difficult to express your feelings?

dialogue.content: 遊びに行く場所、食べる物等、人と一緒に物事を決める時が多い気がします。後、自分の考えを言わなくてはいけない場は辛いです。
dialogue.English: I think it's often when I'm deciding things with other people, like where to go or what to eat. Also, situations where I have to state my own opinion are painful.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 人と物事を決めるときは、どう答えていいかプレッシャーがかかってしまう感じでしょうか❔とても、つらいですよね
dialogue.English: When you're deciding things with others, does it feel like there's pressure about how to respond? That must be very difficult.

dialogue.content: 人に合わせてしまう事が多いです。
dialogue.English: I often end up just going along with others.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 相手の気持ちに合わせられるハナさんの優しい気持ちが、お相手にも伝わってると思いますよ
dialogue.English: I think your kindness in being able to attune to others' feelings comes across to them as well, Hana.

dialogue.content: 自分の言う事聞いてくれる、都合の良い人と思われてるかも知れないです 汗
dialogue.English: I'm afraid they might just see me as a 'convenient' person who will go along with whatever they say.

dialogue.content: ハナさんはそう思うこともあるんですね
dialogue.English: So you sometimes feel that way, Hana.

dialogue.content: 友達によってはです...
dialogue.English: It depends on the friend...

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。お相手でその時の反応は変わりますか❔
dialogue.English: I see. Does the reaction in those situations change depending on the person?

dialogue.content: その時の反応？私の友達に対する感情ですか？
dialogue.English: The reaction? Do you mean my feelings toward my friends?

dialogue.content: その時のお友達の感じ方はわからないかもしれませんがお互いの雰囲気はどうかなと思って。おききしてしました。
dialogue.English: We may not know exactly how your friends feel in that moment, but I was wondering about the atmosphere between you. That’s why I asked.

dialogue.content: お聴きしました。すみません訂正です
dialogue.English: My apologies, I misspoke.

dialogue.content: 相手にとって居心地の良い人を演じている感じなので、雰囲気は良いと思います。
dialogue.English: I feel like I'm playing the part of someone who is easy to be around, so I think the atmosphere is good.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: それは、相手はとても居心地いいでしょうね。ハナさんは、それで疲れてしまうんですね
dialogue.English: That must be very comfortable for the other person. But it's what ends up tiring you out, isn't it, Hana?

dialogue.content: ずっと続くと、疲れてきます...
dialogue.English: If it goes on for a long time, it gets tiring...

dialogue.content: そうなりますよね。流石にずっとだと
dialogue.English: That makes sense. Especially if it's all the time.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ハナさんは、お相手に自分の気持ちを聞かれることはないですか？何か決めるとき等
dialogue.English: Hana, does the other person ever ask you what you want? For example, when you're deciding on something.

dialogue.content: あります。でもその人が望みそうな返事を、条件反射でしてしまう感じです...
dialogue.English: They do. But I feel like I reflexively end up giving the answer I think they want to hear...

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。とても、お相手のこと考えられてるんですね
dialogue.English: I see. You're very considerate of the other person's feelings.

dialogue.content: 嫌われたくないだけかも...
dialogue.English: It might just be that I don’t want to be disliked...

dialogue.content: そうなんですか❔嫌われるの怖いですもんね。今日の相談したいことで、お話しできてないことはありませんか❔大丈夫ですか
dialogue.English: I see. It's scary to be disliked, isn't it? Regarding what you wanted to discuss today, is there anything else we haven't covered?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes, that's everything.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。たまに言いやすそうな、お友達であれば自分の気持ちが話の流れで持っていけそうであればいいですよね
dialogue.English: Thank you. With friends who seem easier to talk to, it would be nice if you could naturally bring your own feelings into the flow of conversation.

dialogue.content: そうですね...
dialogue.English: That's true...

dialogue.content: そうだといいですよね
dialogue.English: It would be good if that were the case, wouldn't it?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 今日は相談してみてもどうでしたか❔
dialogue.English: How did you feel about talking about this today?

dialogue.content: 自分の気持ちを表現するって難しいですね...
dialogue.English: Expressing my own feelings is difficult, isn't it...

dialogue.content: そうですよね。本当に難しいと思います。
dialogue.English: It is, isn't it? I think it's truly difficult.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 私自身もよくあることなので、とても、お気持ちが伝わってきましたので
dialogue.English: It's something I often experience myself, so I could really relate to how you're feeling.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: また相談してみたいことがありましたら、いつでも相談に来てくださいね。今回は解決出来なかったかもしれませんが、ハナさんの、お気持ちが少しでも楽になれたら嬉しいです。
dialogue.English: If there's anything else you'd like to talk about, please feel free to come back anytime. We may not have resolved everything this time, but I hope you feel even a little lighter, Hana.

dialogue.content: 話せただけで、少しすっきりしました笑また、色々聞いてください笑
dialogue.English: Just being able to talk about it made me feel a bit refreshed, haha. Please listen to me again sometime!

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました！
dialogue.English: Thank you very much!

dialogue.content: 是非またよろしくお願いいたします
dialogue.English: I'd be happy to speak with you again anytime.

dialogue.content: こちらこそありがとうございました。失礼します
dialogue.English: Thank you as well. Take care.
